title: The Real Reasons Birth Rates Are Declining Worldwide

mock_data.title: The Real Reasons Birth Rates Are Declining Worldwide
mock_data.passage:
A New Scientist interview by Penny Sarchet with cognitive and evolutionary anthropologist Paula Sheppard on the real reasons why birth rates are falling globally, and what most analyses are missing.

The fall is astonishing. At its height, the global fertility rate hit 5.3 births per woman in 1963, but it has been in near-constant decline ever since. Sixty years on, it is now only around 2.2. In many countries, it is far lower than the roughly 2.1 babies per woman that would sustain current population sizes, known as the replacement rate.

There is no shortage of explanations touted for this global trend, and these are easily tinged by personal or political beliefs: having children has become too expensive, women are too busy working and there isn't enough childcare support.

With the birth rate now sitting at about 1.4 to 1.6 in countries like the UK, Australia and the US – and as low as 1.2 in Japan and 0.75 in South Korea – our understanding of the global fertility decline has so far been driven by demographers, who take whole-population views and try to predict the future.

What this misses, argues Paula Sheppard, a cognitive and evolutionary anthropologist at the University of Oxford, are the nuances: which groups of society are having fewer children, and the different reasons why.

Her more individual-based approach is unpicking the real reasons why men and women are delaying starting a family, and having fewer children when they do.

From urban isolation to modern office work, she tells New Scientist why her research is revealing how modern life is at odds with the way our species evolved to raise its young – and the one factor that people care about the most when deciding how many children to have.

Penny Sarchet: There seems to be a lot of panic about birth rates at the moment.

Paula Sheppard: There's a misconception: people think they've never been this low before, but they're actually not [a record low]. After the second world war, rates were very low as well, and demographers, politicians and policy-makers were panicking. Demographers were trying to project what the population would look like – would birth rates recover? But the projections made in the late 1940s, when people weren't having many babies after the war, were lower than what actually turned out to happen. Nobody got it right, because no one predicted the baby boom.

So, it is hard to predict what will happen, but we are below replacement rate. There are very low rates, especially if you look at South Korea and Japan. But also across Europe and North America, no country is above replacement rate.

Is all the alarm about this justified?

I don't think so. There are [nearly] 9 billion people on the planet. We're not going to go extinct any time soon. There's also the opposite argument of, "Oh my God, we've overpopulated the world. People are starving. Poverty and inequality are terrible." This is what the younger generation, especially, is thinking about.

But I understand why certain media outlets like to push panic, and certain politicians have their own agendas. I don't think we should panic, but at the same time, I think if people want to have two or three kids, they should be able to have two or three kids – but often they aren't.

What do most studies miss when they attempt to investigate falling birth rates?

One issue is the difference between thinking about things at a population level and thinking about things among individuals on the ground. It's not super helpful [to do the former]. If you take a country's total fertility rate, it doesn't tell you anything about different sectors of society, because different people are doing different things. Poorer people have more kids [than average], and very wealthy people have more kids. There's more nuance than can be seen at the country level.

You've been using a unique approach for studying family planning at a more individual level. How did you go about doing this?

I did a study in the UK, which I am now planning to expand to other countries, that was a mixed-methods project. We held focus groups, asking people to talk about it, including men as well, as men are often lost from this conversation and I was very keen to hear what they had to say.

From this qualitative work, I derived a shortlist of the most important things to people when it comes to having children: support from families, having a good house, having a committed and hands-on partner – all these sorts of things you might expect.

And then I did a discrete choice experiment, which is quite unusual for this kind of research – I think I'm the first person to do it. It's quite a well-known method in health economics and transport science. For example, you can use it to investigate why people would choose to take a bus or a train, or how you might persuade more nurses to work in rural areas. So, I used it to ask, how do you make it easier for people to have the number of children they'd like? What do you need to give them?

How does that capture the nuance that is usually missed when investigating birth rates?

Because the experiment runs online, you can have a much bigger, nationally representative participant pool, which we did, although it is worth noting that the majority of the participants were heterosexual. And I was able to pull out rankings for each of the factors on the shortlist and look at things like how many more months you would be willing to wait to start a family in order to have a hands-on partner or a good house, for example.

What did you find?

Unsurprisingly, different things for different groups. There was congruence between men and women, but there was much more difference between educational categories.

People who didn't have a university degree were definitely interested in housing, but they were not [as] interested in mortgages, for example. The men were interested in neighbourhood quality: "I'm not going to have another kid unless I can move to a nicer place, because there's no green space here and the schools are crap." And the women were going, "I just want enough space for the kids to run around and a bit of a garden – but I'm not interested in mortgage debt."

So, if you think about stamp duty holidays [a UK tax measure to encourage home buying], you are only helping the part of the population who want to own a house. But there are people who don't want that kind of debt and are happy to rent, despite it being so difficult to rent in the UK. So perhaps a two-pronged approach is needed.

How were the people who had been to university different?

The women who had degrees really wanted fathers to co-parent. Women who didn't have degrees never talked about wanting guys to change nappies and stuff. Instead, they talked about committed relationships. The worst-case scenario in the whole experiment was being left alone with a baby as a single mum. But women with higher education wanted fathers to be hands-on, which is a different kind of support.

I've wondered if women simply don't want to have the replacement level of children, and women with more education have more control over how many children they have. But your work has found that they are having fewer children than they would like?

Absolutely. People still want two or three kids. Not everyone does – there are always some people who don't want kids at all. But in the UK, for every three babies that are wanted, only two are born.

However, higher-educated women are quite prepared not to have kids unless they're sure that the father is going to invest as heavily as they are as a co-parent. I think it is because women take a higher career penalty. Women are saying, "It's not just a year's maternity leave. I'm going to lose so much more on my progression at work that I need to wait until I'm really established in my career." That's what drives the association between education level and having fewer children. The higher-educated men are saying, "When she's ready, I'm ready", but those women are waiting for a man who is prepared to muck in.

What did the men who had been to university care most about?

They were looking for things like job flexibility – the ability to take leave and work from home when needed. That speaks a lot to being able to be a hands-on parent. I think it's very important to think about better parental leave for men, because that's beneficial for the kids, as well as the relationships between fathers and their children, and it's also beneficial for women.

It famously takes a village to raise a child and, due to urbanisation, more people than ever don't have that village.

This is the crux of the matter. Social support was the most important thing in the study. A defining feature of our species is that female humans are able to have multiple dependent children at once. You don't see this in chimpanzees, for example. They wait until the offspring is old enough so that if the mother dies, the young can survive, and then they have another one – so every seven years or so. With humans, you can have kids every two years or so, and if the mother dies, the children won't die because there's a father, grandparents or a "village".

This cooperative breeding is literally what makes us human, and in every group I studied, they wanted support from their partner or their parents. The higher-educated women also wanted friends' support – they wanted to know that there were mothers' groups they could join and that their friends were also having kids.

It's often suggested that the high cost of living is why people are having fewer children – that the associated housing and childcare costs have become just too expensive. Did that come out as an important factor in your study?

The cost of living and finances around childcare were important across the board, but, interestingly, not as much as other things like your partner or other sources of social support. This makes sense, because if you have a good support network to rely on, the cost of childcare can be reduced. For instance, if grandparents can take care of the children one or two days a week, that can translate into a fair whack of savings.

You found that higher-educated women see it as unusual to have children before their 30s, which is quite old, anthropologically speaking. What's driven this?

I think the reason people are waiting that long is because families are struggling to have all their proverbial ducks in a row before they're ready to have a family – or have another child. If you made work and parenting more compatible, I think people would have kids younger.

And then, starting a family later leaves people with less time to have as many children as they would ideally want?

Yes – a lot of the gap between the number of children you want and the number of children you get is driven by delay. And it's not just in higher-educated women: other women are having babies later, too, in their late 20s.

To what extent does all this apply globally?

It's not just Europe. The only part of the world that doesn't have very low fertility is sub-Saharan Africa, but it's going that way; it's just a matter of time.

But globally, there are completely different things at play. In Bangladesh, for example, fertility is low – around 2 children per family – but women [typically] get married young, around when they're 18. They have their first baby when they're 19, their second baby when they're 22, and then they stop, so they're also having fewer kids, but it's nothing to do with this delay business that we are seeing in the UK.

I have heard it said that it's much easier to bring birth rates down – through education and contraception availability, for example – than it is to get them up. Worldwide, are there any policies that have worked?

I don't think there really are. France has the highest fertility rate in western and northern Europe, but it is low – around 1.7 children per woman. Amid all the headlines and political commentary around birth rates, what's the one thing you wish people could know about the issue?

It is about making parenting and working compatible, whatever that means for different people, and stopping pitting them against each other. They always used to be compatible. Women have always worked and they have always had kids. It's just that now we live in this patriarchal setting: the office is the office, and children don't go there. Instead, let's change this whole culture.

They have their first baby when they're 19, their second baby when they're 22, and then they stop, so they're also having fewer kids, but it's nothing to do with this delay business that we are seeing in the UK.

I have heard it said that it's much easier to bring birth rates down – through education and contraception availability, for example – than it is to get them up. Worldwide, are there any policies that have worked?

I don't think there really are. France has the highest fertility rate in western and northern Europe, but it is low – around 1.7 children per woman. That's attributed to better policies: heavily subsidised childcare, incentives for having children. But, like in Nordic countries, which are leading the way [in gender-equality parenting policies], it still doesn't translate into big increases. The Nordic countries still have low fertility. Policies can have short-term changes, maybe, but they can't make everyone start having four kids. There's no silver bullet.

Amid all the headlines and political commentary around birth rates, what's the one thing you wish people could know about the issue?

It is about making parenting and working compatible, whatever that means for different people, and stopping pitting them against each other. They always used to be compatible. Women have always worked and they have always had kids. It's just that now we live in this patriarchal setting: the office is the office, and children don't go there. Instead, let's change this whole culture.
mock_data.passageC1: Ultimately, Sheppard argues that the key to addressing the decline in birth rates lies in creating a society that supports both work and parenting, allowing individuals to balance their professional aspirations with their desire to raise a family. This requires a fundamental shift in cultural attitudes, one that recognizes the value of both paid work and caregiving and challenges the traditional notion that these two spheres are inherently incompatible. By fostering a more supportive and equitable environment for parents, societies can pave the way for a more sustainable demographic future.

mock_data.translation:
Penni Sarchet tomonidan yozilgan New Scientist intervyusi — kognitiv va evolyutsion antropolog Paula Sheppard bilan butun dunyoda tug'ilish darajasi pasayishining haqiqiy sabablari va ko'pchilik tahlillar nimani o'tkazib yuborayotgani haqida.

Pasayish hayratlanarli. Eng yuqori darajasida, global fertillik darajasi 1963-yilda har bir ayolga 5,3 ta tug'ilishga yetdi, lekin o'shandan beri deyarli doimiy pasayishda. Oltmish yil o'tib, hozir u atigi taxminan 2,2 ni tashkil etadi. Ko'p mamlakatlarda bu joriy aholi sonini saqlab turishi mumkin bo'lgan har bir ayolga taxminan 2,1 chaqaloqdan ancha past, bu almashtirish darajasi deb ataladi.

Ushbu global tendentsiya uchun ko'plab izohlar mavjud va ular shaxsiy yoki siyosiy e'tiqodlar bilan oson bo'yaladi: bolali bo'lish juda qimmat bo'lib qoldi, ayollar juda band ishlaydi va bolaga qarash uchun yetarli yordam yo'q.

Tug'ilish darajasi hozirda Buyuk Britaniya, Avstraliya va AQSh kabi mamlakatlarda taxminan 1,4 dan 1,6 gacha — va Yaponiyada 1,2, Janubiy Koreyada esa 0,75 gacha past bo'lgan holda — global fertillik pasayishini tushunishimiz hozirgacha aholi bo'yicha umumiy ko'rinishlarni olib, kelajakni bashorat qilishga urinadigan demograflar tomonidan boshqarilgan.

Oksford universitetidagi kognitiv va evolyutsion antropolog Paula Sheppardning fikricha, bu yetishmayotgan narsa — nozikliklar: jamiyatning qaysi guruhlari kamroq farzand ko'rmoqda va turli sabablar.

Uning ko'proq individual yondashuvga asoslangan usuli erkaklar va ayollar nima uchun oila qurishni kechiktirayotgani va farzandli bo'lganlarida kamroq ko'rayotganining haqiqiy sabablarini ochib bermoqda.

Shahar izolyatsiyasidan zamonaviy ofis ishigacha, u New Scientistga zamonaviy hayot turlarimiz o'z yoshlarini tarbiyalash uchun evolyutsiya qilgan usulga nima uchun zid ekanligini — va odamlar nechta farzand ko'rish haqida qaror qilishda eng ko'p e'tibor beradigan omilni aytadi.

Penni Sarchet: Hozirda tug'ilish darajasi haqida juda ko'p vahima bor ko'rinadi.

Paula Sheppard: Noto'g'ri tushuncha bor: odamlar ular hech qachon bu qadar past bo'lmagan deb o'ylashadi, lekin aslida ular [rekord past] emas. Ikkinchi jahon urushidan keyin darajalar ham juda past edi va demograflar, siyosatchilar va siyosat ishlab chiqaruvchilar vahimada edilar. Demograflar aholining qanday ko'rinishini bashorat qilishga urinishdi — tug'ilish darajalari tiklanadimi? Ammo 1940-yillarning oxirida, odamlar urushdan keyin ko'p chaqaloq tug'magan paytda qilingan bashoratlar aslida sodir bo'lganidan past edi. Hech kim to'g'ri aytmadi, chunki hech kim chaqaloqlar portlashini bashorat qilmadi.

Shunday qilib, nima bo'lishini bashorat qilish qiyin, lekin biz almashtirish darajasidan pastmiz. Juda past darajalar bor, ayniqsa Janubiy Koreya va Yaponiyaga qarasangiz. Lekin Yevropa va Shimoliy Amerika bo'ylab ham hech bir mamlakat almashtirish darajasidan yuqori emas.

Bu haqda barcha tashvish oqlanganlimi?

O'ylamayman. Sayyorada [deyarli] 9 milliard odam bor. Biz tez orada yo'q bo'lib ketmaymiz. Qarama-qarshi argument ham bor: "Ey Xudoyim, biz dunyoni ortiqcha aholiga to'ldirdik. Odamlar ochlikdan qiynalmoqda. Qashshoqlik va tengsizlik dahshatli." Bu ayniqsa yosh avlod o'ylayotgan narsa.

Lekin men ba'zi ommaviy axborot vositalari nima uchun vahima tarqatishni yaxshi ko'rishini va ba'zi siyosatchilarning o'z kun tartibiga ega ekanligini tushunaman. Men vahima qilish kerak deb o'ylamayman, lekin shu bilan birga, agar odamlar ikki yoki uch bola ko'rishni xohlasa, ular ikki yoki uch bola ko'rish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lishi kerak — lekin ko'pincha ular buni qila olmaydi.

Ko'pgina tadqiqotlar tug'ilish darajalarining pasayishini o'rganishda nimani o'tkazib yuboradi?

Bitta masala — aholi darajasida narsalar haqida o'ylash va yerdagi shaxslar orasidagi narsalar haqida o'ylash o'rtasidagi farq. [Birinchisini qilish] juda foydali emas. Agar siz mamlakatning umumiy fertillik darajasini olsangiz, u sizga jamiyatning turli sektorlari haqida hech narsa aytmaydi, chunki turli odamlar turli narsalarni qilmoqda. Kambag'alroq odamlar ko'proq bola ko'radi [o'rtachadan], va juda boy odamlar ham ko'proq bola ko'radi. Mamlakat darajasida ko'rish mumkin bo'lganidan ko'ra ko'proq noziklik bor.

Siz oila rejalashtirshini individual darajada o'rganish uchun noyob yondashuvdan foydalanasiz. Buni qanday amalga oshirdingiz?

Men Buyuk Britaniyada tadqiqot o'tkazdim, uni boshqa mamlakatlarga kengaytirmoqchiman, bu aralash usullar loyihasi edi. Biz fokus guruhlarni o'tkazdik, odamlardan bu haqda gapirishni so'radik, shu jumladan erkaklar ham, chunki erkaklar ko'pincha bu suhbatdan chetda qoladi va men ular nima deyishini juda eshitmoqchi edim.

Ushbu sifat tadqiqotidan bola ko'rish haqida odamlar uchun eng muhim narsalarning qisqa ro'yxatini tuzdim: oilalar tomonidan qo'llab-quvvatlash, yaxshi uyga ega bo'lish, sodiq va ishtirokchi sherikka ega bo'lish — siz kutishingiz mumkin bo'lgan barcha turdagi narsalar.

Va keyin men diskret tanlov tajribasini o'tkazdim, bu tadqiqot turi uchun juda g'ayrioddiy — men buni qilgan birinchi odam ekanligimni o'ylayman. Bu sog'liqni saqlash iqtisodiyoti va transport fanida juda taniqli usul. Masalan, uni odamlar nima uchun avtobus yoki poezdni tanlashini yoki qishloq hududlarda ko'proq hamshiralarni ishlashga qanday ko'ndirish mumkinligini o'rganish uchun ishlatish mumkin. Shunday qilib, men uni so'rash uchun ishlatdim: odamlarga xohlagan miqdordagi farzand ko'rishni qanday osonlashtirish mumkin? Ularga nima berishingiz kerak?

Bu odatda tug'ilish darajalarini o'rganishda o'tkazib yuboriladigan noziklikni qanday ushlab qoladi?

Tajriba onlayn o'tkazilgani uchun sizda ancha kattaroq, milliy miqyosda vakillik qiladigan ishtirokchilar havzasi bo'lishi mumkin, biz ham shunday qildik, garchi ishtirokchilarning aksariyati geteroseksual bo'lganligini ta'kidlash kerak. Va men qisqa ro'yxatdagi har bir omil uchun reytinglarni chiqarishga va masalan, ishtirokchi sherik yoki yaxshi uyga ega bo'lish uchun oila qurishni boshlashni necha oy ko'proq kutishga tayyor bo'lishingiz mumkinligini ko'rib chiqishga muvaffaq bo'ldim.

Nima aniqladingiz?

Kutilganidek, turli guruhlar uchun turli narsalar. Erkaklar va ayollar o'rtasida muvofiqlik bor edi, lekin ta'lim toifalari o'rtasida ancha ko'proq farq bor edi.

Universitet diplomiga ega bo'lmagan odamlar, albatta, uy-joy masalasiga qiziqishdi, lekin ular ipotekaga [unchalik] qiziqishmasdi, masalan. Erkaklar mahalla sifatiga qiziqishdi: "Yaxshiroq joyga ko'cha olmasam, boshqa bola ko'rmayman, chunki bu yerda yashil maydon yo'q va maktablar yomon." Va ayollar shunday deyishdi: "Men bolalar yugurib o'ynashi uchun yetarli joy va bir oz bog' — lekin ipoteka qarziga qiziqmayman."

Shunday qilib, agar siz stamp duty ta'tillarini [uy sotib olishni rag'batlantirish uchun Buyuk Britaniya soliq chorasi] o'ylasangiz, siz faqat uy egasi bo'lishni xohlaydigan aholining bir qismiga yordam berasiz. Ammo bunday qarzni xohlamaydigan va ijaraga berishdan mamnun odamlar bor, Buyuk Britaniyada ijaraga olish juda qiyin bo'lishiga qaramay. Shuning uchun ikki tomonlama yondashuv kerak bo'lishi mumkin.

Universitetda o'qigan odamlar qanday farq qildi?

Diplomi bor ayollar haqiqatan ham otalarning birga tarbiyalashini xohlashdi. Diplomi yo'q ayollar yigitlarning taglik almashtirishini va boshqalarni xohlashlari haqida hech gapirmashdi. Buning o'rniga, ular sodiq munosabatlar haqida gapirdilar. Butun tajribadagi eng yomon stsenariy yolg'iz ona sifatida chaqaloq bilan yolg'iz qolish edi. Ammo oliy ma'lumotli ayollar otalarning ishtirokchi bo'lishini xohlashdi, bu boshqacha yordam.

Men ayollar shunchaki almashtirish darajasidagi bolalar ko'rishni xohlamaydi va ko'proq ma'lumotli ayollar nechta farzand ko'rishlarini ko'proq nazorat qiladi deb o'ylagandim. Lekin sizning ishingiz ular xohlganidan kamroq farzand ko'rayotganini aniqladi?

Albatta. Odamlar hali ham ikki yoki uch bola ko'rishni xohlashadi. Hamma emas — har doim bola ko'rishni umuman xohlamaydigan odamlar bor. Ammo Buyuk Britaniyada, xohlangan har uchta chaqaloqdan faqat ikkitasi tug'iladi.

Biroq, oliy ma'lumotli ayollar ota ham ular kabi ko'p sarmoya kiritishiga ishonch hosil qilmasalar, bola ko'rmaslikka tayyor. Men bu ayollar yuqoriroq karyera jazosiga duchor bo'lgani uchun deb o'ylayman. Ayollar shunday deyishdi: "Bu faqat bir yillik tug'ruqdan keyingi ta'til emas. Men ishda o'sishimda shunchalik ko'p yo'qotaman, shuning uchun karyeramda haqiqatan ham mustahkam bo'lgunimcha kutishim kerak." Mana ta'lim darajasi va kamroq farzand ko'rish o'rtasidagi bog'liqlikni haydaydigan narsa. Oliy ma'lumotli erkaklar "U tayyor bo'lganda, men tayyorman" deyishadi, lekin o'sha ayollar birga harakat qilishga tayyor erkakni kutishmoqda.

Universitetda o'qigan erkaklar eng ko'p nimaga e'tibor berdi?

Ular ish moslashuvchanligi kabi narsalarni qidirdilar — kerak bo'lganda ta'til olish va uydan ishlash imkoniyati. Bu ishtirokchi ota-ona bo'lish imkoniyati haqida ko'p narsani aytadi. Men erkaklar uchun yaxshiroq ota-ona ta'tili haqida o'ylash juda muhim deb o'ylayman, chunki bu bolalar uchun foydali, shuningdek otalar va ularning bolalari o'rtasidagi munosabatlar uchun ham, va ayollar uchun ham foydali.

Bolani tarbiyalash uchun butun qishloq kerakligi mashhur va urbanizatsiya tufayli har qachongidan ko'proq odamlar o'sha qishloqqa ega emas.

Masalaning mohiyati shu. Ijtimoiy qo'llab-quvvatlash tadqiqotda eng muhim narsa edi. Bizning turlarimizning belgilovchi xususiyati shundaki, inson ayollari bir vaqtning o'zida bir nechta qaramog'idagi bolalarga ega bo'lishlari mumkin. Buni shimpanzelarda ko'rmaysiz, masalan. Ular nasl yetarlicha katta bo'lgunicha kutishadi, agar ona o'lsa, yosh yashay olishi uchun, va keyin yana birini tug'ishadi — taxminan har yetti yilda. Insonlarda siz taxminan har ikki yilda bola ko'rishingiz mumkin va agar ona o'lsa, bolalar o'lmaydi, chunki ota, buvi-bobolar yoki "qishloq" bor.

Bu kooperativ ko'payish tom ma'noda bizni inson qiladigan narsa va men o'rgangan har bir guruhda ular sherigidan yoki ota-onalaridan yordam olishni xohlashdi. Oliy ma'lumotli ayollar do'stlarining yordamini ham xohlashdi — ular qo'shilishlari mumkin bo'lgan onalar guruhlari borligini va do'stlarining ham bola ko'rayotganini bilishni xohlashdi.

Ko'pincha yuqori turmush xarajatlari odamlarning kamroq farzand ko'rish sababi — uy-joy va bolaga qarash xarajatlari juda qimmat bo'lib qoldi deb aytiladi. Bu sizning tadqiqotingizda muhim omil sifatida chiqdidhji?

Turmush xarajatlari va bolaga qarash atrofidagi moliyaviy masalalar barcha guruhlar uchun muhim edi, lekin qiziqarli tomoni shundaki, sherigingiz yoki ijtimoiy qo'llab-quvvatlashning boshqa manbalari kabi boshqa narsalar kabi emas. Bu mantiqiy, chunki agar sizda tayanish uchun yaxshi qo'llab-quvvatlash tarmog'i bo'lsa, bolaga qarash xarajatlari kamayishi mumkin. Masalan, buvi-bobolar haftada bir yoki ikki kun bolalarga qarashlari mumkin bo'lsa, bu anchagina tejashga aylanishi mumkin.

Siz oliy ma'lumotli ayollar 30 yoshdan oldin bola ko'rishni g'ayrioddiy deb hisoblashini aniqladingiz, bu antropologik nuqtai nazardan ancha katta. Buni nima haydadi?

Odamlarning shuncha uzoq kutishining sababi oilalar oila qurishga tayyor bo'lishdan oldin — yoki boshqa bola ko'rishdan oldin — barcha ishlarini tartibga solish uchun kurashayotgani deb o'ylayman. Agar siz ish va ota-onalikni ko'proq mos qilsangiz, odamlar yoshroq paytda bola ko'rishadi deb o'ylayman.

Va keyin, oilani keyinroq boshlash odamlarga ideal holda xohlagan miqdordagi farzand ko'rish uchun kamroq vaqt qoldiradi?

Ha — siz xohlagan bolalar soni va siz olgan bolalar soni o'rtasidagi bo'shliqning katta qismi kechikish tufayli. Va bu faqat oliy ma'lumotli ayollarda emas: boshqa ayollar ham keyinroq, 20 yoshlarining oxirida chaqaloq tug'ishmoqda.

Bularning barchasi global miqyosda qanchalik qo'llaniladi?

Bu faqat Yevropa emas. Dunyoning juda past fertillikka ega bo'lmagan yagona qismi sub-Sahara Afrikasi, lekin u ham o'sha yo'nalishda ketmoqda; bu faqat vaqt masalasi.

Ammo global miqyosda butunlay boshqa narsalar ta'sir qilmoqda. Bangladeshda, masalan, fertillik past — oilasiga taxminan 2 ta bola — lekin ayollar [odatda] yosh turmush quradi, taxminan 18 yoshlarida. Ular birinchi chaqaloqni 19 yoshida, ikkinchisini 22 yoshida ko'radi va keyin to'xtaydi, shuning uchun ular ham kamroq bola ko'rmoqda, lekin bu Buyuk Britaniyada ko'rayotgan kechikish bilan hech qanday aloqasi yo'q.

Tug'ilish darajalarini pasaytirish — ta'lim va kontratseptsiya mavjudligi orqali, masalan — ularni ko'tarishdan osonroq deganlarni eshitganman. Butun dunyoda ishlaydigan siyosatlar bormi?

Haqiqatan ham bor deb o'ylamayman. Frantsiya g'arbiy va shimoliy Yevropada eng yuqori fertillik darajasiga ega, lekin u past — har bir ayolga taxminan 1,7 ta bola. Ammo, gender-tenglik ota-onalik siyosatlarda yetakchilik qilayotgan Skandinaviya mamlakatlari kabi, bu hali ham katta o'sishga aylanmaydi. Skandinaviya mamlakatlari hali ham past fertillikka ega. Siyosatlar qisqa muddatli o'zgarishlarga olib kelishi mumkin, balki, lekin ular hammani to'rtta bola ko'rishga majbur qila olmaydi. Sehrli tayoq yo'q.

Tug'ilish darajalari atrofidagi barcha sarlavhalar va siyosiy sharhlar orasida, siz odamlar bu masala haqida bilishlarini istagan bitta narsa nima?

Gap ota-onalik va ishlashni mos qilish haqida, bu turli odamlar uchun nimani anglatsa ham, va ularni bir-biriga qarshi qo'yishni to'xtatish haqida. Ular har doim mos edi. Ayollar har doim ishlagan va har doim bola ko'rgan. Faqat hozir biz ushbu patriarxal muhitda yashaymiz: ofis — ofis va bolalar u yerga bormaydi. Buning o'rniga, keling, butun madaniyatni o'zgartiraylik.

Bu "New Scientist" jurnalidan Paula Sheppard bilan intervyu. U odamlarning qanday fikrlashi va vaqt o'tishi bilan qanday o'zgarganimizni o'rganadi. U dunyo bo'ylab nima uchun kamroq chaqaloq tug'ilayotgani haqida gapiradi. Ko'plab tadqiqotlar buning haqiqiy sabablarini ko'rmaydi.

Tug'ilayotgan chaqaloqlar soni juda kamaydi. 1963 yilda ayollar har biri o'rtacha 5,3 ta chaqaloq tug'dirgan. Hozir bu ko'rsatkich taxminan 2,2 tani tashkil etadi. Ko'pgina mamlakatlarda bu 2,1 dan past, bu aholini bir xilda saqlash uchun zarur bo'lgan raqamdir.

Odamlarda buning sababi haqida ko'plab fikrlar mavjud. Ba'zilarning aytishicha, bola ko'rish juda qimmatga tushadi. Boshqalar esa ayollar ish bilan band, yoki bolalarni parvarish qilishda yetarli yordam yo'q deyishadi.

Buyuk Britaniya, Avstraliya va AQSh kabi mamlakatlarda chaqaloqlar soni bir ayolga taxminan 1,4 dan 1,6 gacha. Yaponiyada bu 1,2, Janubiy Koreyada esa atigi 0,75. Bu muammo bo'yicha ko'pgina tadqiqotlar aholini o'rganadigan odamlar tomonidan amalga oshiriladi. Ular kelajakda nima bo'lishini taxmin qilishga harakat qilishadi.

Paula Sheppardning aytishicha, bu tadqiqotlar kichik tafsilotlarni ko'rmaydi. Ular aholining qaysi guruhlarida kamroq bola tug'ilayotganini va nima uchun ekanligini ko'rib chiqmaydi. U odamlarning nima uchun bolali bo'lishni kechiktirayotganini va nima uchun kamroq bola tug'dirayotganini bilish uchun ularni individual ravishda o'rganadi.

Uning aytishicha, zamonaviy hayot ajdodlarimiz yashagan hayotga o'xshamaydi. Bizning tanalarimiz va ongimiz bolalarni tarbiyalashning boshqa usuli uchun yaratilgan. U, shuningdek, odamlar qancha bola ko'rish haqida qaror qabul qilishda eng muhim narsa ekanligini aytadi.

Penny Sarchet: Odamlar tug'ilayotgan chaqaloqlar sonidan juda xavotirda tuyuladi.

Paula Sheppard: Odamlar raqamlar hech qachon bunchalik past bo'lmagan deb o'ylashadi, lekin bu to'g'ri emas. Ikkinchi jahon urushidan keyin ham raqamlar juda past edi. Aholini o'rganuvchilar o'shanda ham xavotirda edilar. Ular aholi qanchalik katta bo'lishini taxmin qilishga harakat qilishdi. Ular chaqaloqlar soni pastligicha qoladi deb o'ylashdi, lekin adashishdi. Ular baby bumini taxmin qila olishmadi.

Demak, nima bo'lishini taxmin qilish qiyin. Ammo raqamlar hozir juda past, ayniqsa Janubiy Koreya va Yaponiyada. Yevropa va Shimoliy Amerikada esa aholini bir xilda saqlash uchun yetarli chaqaloqqa ega bo'lgan birorta ham davlat yo'q.

Bundan shunchalik xavotirlanish to'g'rimi?

Menimcha yo'q. Yer yuzida deyarli 9 milliard odam bor. Biz tez orada yo'q bo'lib ketmaymiz. Ba'zilar odamlar juda ko'p deb o'ylashadi. Ularning aytishicha, odamlar och, qashshoqlik ko'p. Yoshlar bu haqda o'ylashadi.

Ammo men ba'zi yangiliklar kompaniyalari va siyosatchilar nima uchun odamlarni xavotirlantirishni xohlashlarini bilaman. Men vahima qilishimiz kerak deb o'ylamayman. Ammo agar odamlar ikki yoki uchta farzand ko'rishni xohlashsa, ular buni qila olishlari kerak. Ko'pincha, ular qila olishmaydi.

Kamroq chaqaloq tug'ilishining sababini aniqlashga urinayotganda, ko'pgina tadqiqotlar nimani o'tkazib yuboradi?

Muammolardan biri shundaki, ular individual odamlarga emas, balki butun aholiga qarashadi. Bu unchalik foydali emas. Agar siz mamlakatdagi chaqaloqlarning umumiy soniga qarasangiz, bu sizga turli guruhlar haqida hech narsa aytmaydi. Ba'zi odamlar boshqalarga qaraganda ko'proq farzand ko'rishadi. Misol uchun, kambag'al odamlar va juda boy odamlar o'rtachadan ko'ra ko'proq farzand ko'rishadi. Butun mamlakatga qaraganingizda ko'ra olmaydigan ko'plab kichik tafsilotlar mavjud.

Siz oilani rejalashtirishni o'rganishning maxsus usulidan foydalanmoqdasiz, odamlarga yaqinroq nazar tashlab. Buni qanday qildingiz?

Men Buyuk Britaniyada tadqiqot o'tkazdim. Men xuddi shu tadqiqotni boshqa mamlakatlarda ham o'tkazishni rejalashtiryapman. Men odamlardan guruhlarda bola ko'rish haqida gapirishlarini so'radim. Men erkaklardan ham so'radim, chunki ular ko'pincha bu suhbatlarga kiritilmaydi. Men ularning nima deyishlarini eshitmoqchi edim.

Bu suhbatlardan men odamlar bola ko'rish haqida o'ylashganda eng muhim bo'lgan narsalar ro'yxatini tuzdim. Bu narsalar: oiladan yordam, yaxshi uy va ko'p yordam beradigan sherik. Bular siz kutishingiz mumkin bo'lgan narsalar.

Keyin men tajriba o'tkazdim. Bu odatda bunday tadqiqotda qilinmaydi. Menimcha, buni qilgan birinchi odamman. Bu tajriba sog'liqni saqlash va transport tadqiqotlarida qo'llaniladi. Misol uchun, siz odamlarning nima uchun avtobus yoki poyezdda yurishini aniqlash uchun undan foydalanishingiz mumkin. Yoki siz qishloqda ko'proq hamshiralarni ishlashga qanday jalb qilishni aniqlash uchun undan foydalanishingiz mumkin. Men undan shunday savol berish uchun foydalandim: odamlarga xohlagan miqdorda farzand ko'rishni osonlashtirish uchun nima qila olamiz? Odamlarga nima kerak?

Bu tug'ilish darajasini o'rganishda odatda o'tkazib yuboriladigan kichik tafsilotlarni qanday ko'rsatadi?

Tajriba onlayn tarzda amalga oshiriladi. Shunday qilib, men butun mamlakat bo'ylab ko'plab odamlarni ishtirok ettirishim mumkin edi. Odamlarning aksariyati heteroseksual munosabatlarda edi. Men ro'yxatdagi har bir narsaning odamlar uchun qanchalik muhimligini ko'rishim mumkin edi. Misol uchun, agar ularning ko'p yordam beradigan sherigi bo'lsa yoki yaxshi uyi bo'lsa, odamlar oila qurishni boshlash uchun qancha oylarga ko'proq kutishlarini ko'rishim mumkin edi.

Nima aniqladingiz?

Javoblar turli guruhlar uchun har xil edi. Erkaklar va ayollar ba'zi narsalarda rozi bo'lishdi. Ammo turli darajadagi ta'limga ega odamlar o'rtasida katta farqlar bor edi.

Universitetga bormagan odamlar uyga ega bo'lishga qiziqish bildirishdi. Ammo ular ipoteka olishga qiziqish bildirishmadi. Erkaklar mahallaning sifatiga qiziqish bildirishdi. Ularning aytishicha, agar ular yaxshiroq joyga ko'chib o'ta olmasalar, boshqa farzand ko'rmaydilar, chunki u yerda yashil maydon yo'q va maktablar yomon. Ayollar bolalar o'ynashi uchun yetarli joy va kichik bog'ni xohlashlarini aytishdi. Ammo ular ko'p qarzdor bo'lishga qiziqish bildirishmadi.

Shunday qilib, agar siz odamlarga uy sotib olishni osonlashtirsangiz, siz faqat uyga ega bo'lishni xohlaydigan odamlarga yordam berayotgan bo'lasiz. Ba'zi odamlar bunday qarzdorlikni xohlashmaydi. Ular Buyuk Britaniyada ijaraga olish qiyin bo'lsa ham, ijarada yashashdan xursandlar. Demak, biz odamlarga yordam berish uchun ikkita narsani qilishimiz kerak bo'lishi mumkin.

Universitetga borgan odamlar qanday farq qilishdi?

Oliy ma'lumotli ayollar otalarning bolalarni tarbiyalashda yordam berishlarini juda xohlashdi. Oliy ma'lumoti bo'lmagan ayollar hech qachon erkaklarning tagliklarini almashtirish va shunga o'xshash narsalar haqida gapirishmagan. Buning o'rniga, ular sodiq munosabatda bo'lish haqida gapirishdi. Tajribadagi eng yomon narsa yolg'iz ona sifatida chaqaloq bilan qolish edi. Ammo oliy ma'lumotli ayollar otalarning ko'p yordam berishlarini xohlashdi. Bu boshqa turdagi yordam.

Men ayollar shunchaki aholini bir xilda saqlash uchun yetarli farzand ko'rishni xohlashmaydimi deb o'yladim. Ehtimol, ko'proq ta'lim olgan ayollar qancha farzand ko'rishni nazorat qilish imkoniyatiga ega. Ammo sizning ishingiz ularning xohlaganidan kamroq farzand ko'rayotganini aniqladi?

Ha, to'g'ri. Odamlar hali ham ikki yoki uchta farzand ko'rishni xohlashadi. Hamma ham emas. Ba'zi odamlar umuman farzand ko'rishni xohlashmaydi. Ammo Buyuk Britaniyada odamlar xohlagan har uchta chaqaloqdan faqat ikkitasi tug'iladi.

Oliy ma'lumotli ayollar otaning o'zlari kabi yordam berishiga ishonch hosil qilmaguncha, farzand ko'rishga tayyor emaslar. Shuning uchun ta'lim darajasi va kamroq farzand ko'rish o'rtasida bog'liqlik bor. Oliy ma'lumotli erkaklar: "U tayyor bo'lsa, men tayyorman", deyishadi. Ammo bu ayollar yordam berishga tayyor bo'lgan erkakni kutishadi.

Universitetga borgan erkaklar nimaga ko'proq e'tibor berishdi?

Ular ishda moslashuvchanlik kabi narsalarni qidirishdi. Ular kerak bo'lganda ta'til olish va uydan ishlash imkoniyatiga ega bo'lishni xohlashdi. Bu ularga amaliy ota-ona bo'lish imkonini beradi. Men erkaklar uchun yaxshiroq ota-onalik ta'tiliga ega bo'lish juda muhim deb o'ylayman. Bu bolalar uchun, otalar va ularning farzandlari o'rtasidagi munosabatlar uchun va ayollar uchun yaxshi.

Bolani tarbiyalash uchun qishloq kerak deyiladi. Ko'proq odamlar shaharlarda yashaganligi sababli, ko'pchilikda bunday qishloq yo'q.

Bu eng muhim nuqta. Ijtimoiy qo'llab-quvvatlash tadqiqotdagi eng muhim narsa edi. Odamlarni o'ziga xos qiladigan narsalardan biri shundaki, ayollar bir vaqtning o'zida yordamga muhtoj bo'lgan ko'plab farzandlarga ega bo'lishlari mumkin. Shimpanzalar buni qilmaydi. Ular onasi o'lsa ham, farzandlari omon qolish uchun yetarlicha katta bo'lguncha kutishadi. Keyin ular har yetti yilda bir marta boshqa farzand ko'rishadi. Odamlar har ikki yilda bir marta farzand ko'rishlari mumkin. Agar ona vafot etsa, bolalar o'lmaydi, chunki ota, bobo-buvi yoki "qishloq" bor.

Bu hamkorlikdagi naslchilik bizni inson qiladi. Men o'rgangan har bir guruhda odamlar sherigi yoki ota-onalari tomonidan yordam olishni xohlashdi. Oliy ma'lumotli ayollar ham do'stlaridan yordam olishni xohlashdi. Ular qo'shilishlari mumkin bo'lgan onalar guruhlari borligini va do'stlari ham farzand ko'rayotganini bilishni xohlashdi.

Odamlar ko'pincha yashash narxi yuqori bo'lgani uchun odamlar kamroq farzand ko'rishadi deyishadi. Ular uy-joy va bolalar parvarishi juda qimmat deyishadi. Bu sizning tadqiqotingizda muhim narsami edi?

Yashash narxi va bolalar parvarishi hamma uchun muhim edi. Ammo ular sherigingiz yoki boshqa ijtimoiy qo'llab-quvvatlash kabi boshqa narsalar kabi muhim emas edi. Bu mantiqiy. Misol uchun, agar bobo va buvilar haftasiga bir yoki ikki kun bolalarga qarashsa, bu juda ko'p pulni tejashga yordam beradi.

Siz oliy ma'lumotli ayollar 30 yoshdan keyin farzand ko'rishni odatiy hol deb o'ylashlarini aniqladingiz. Bu odamlar ilgari farzand ko'rganiga nisbatan juda katta yosh. Buning sababi nima?

Ha. Siz xohlagan farzandlar soni va siz olgan farzandlar soni o'rtasidagi farqning katta qismi odamlar kutganligi sababli yuzaga keladi. Bu faqat oliy ma'lumotli ayollarga tegishli emas. Boshqa ayollar ham 20 yoshlarning oxirida, kechroq farzand ko'rishadi.

Bularning barchasi dunyo bo'ylab qanchalik sodir bo'ladi?

Bu faqat Yevropada emas. Dunyoning tug'ilish darajasi juda past bo'lmagan yagona qismi Sahroi Kabirdan janubdagi Afrika. Ammo u o'sha tomonga ketyapti. Bu shunchaki vaqt masalasi.

Ammo ayollar yosh turmushga chiqishadi, taxminan 18 yoshda. Ular birinchi bolasini 19 yoshda, ikkinchi bolasini 22 yoshda tug'ishadi, keyin to'xtashadi. Demak, ular ham kamroq farzand ko'rishmoqda. Ammo bu Buyuk Britaniyadagidek kutayotganlari uchun emas.

Men tug'ilish darajasini oshirishga qaraganda, uni pasaytirish ancha oson ekanligini eshitdim. Misol uchun, siz odamlarga ta'lim berish va kontratseptsiya vositalarini berish orqali ularni pasaytirishingiz mumkin. Tug'ilish darajasini oshirishga yordam bergan biron bir narsa bormi?

Sheppardning ta'kidlashicha, mavjud tahlillarning ko'pchiligi muammoning muhim jihatlariga e'tibor bermaydi.

Tug'ilish darajasining pasayishi juda keskin. 1963-yilda global tug'ilish koeffitsienti har bir ayolga 5,3 ta tug'ilish bilan eng yuqori ko'rsatkichga yetdi. Biroq, shundan beri u doimiy ravishda kamayib bormoqda. Hozir, oltmish yil o'tgach, u taxminan 2,2 ni tashkil qiladi. Ko'pgina mamlakatlarda bu ko'rsatkich joriy aholi sonini saqlab qolish uchun zarur bo'lgan har bir ayolga taxminan 2,1 chaqaloqdan iborat o'rnini bosish darajasidan ancha past.

Bu global tendentsiyani tushuntirish uchun ko'plab izohlar ilgari surilgan. Biroq, bular ko'pincha shaxsiy yoki siyosiy fikrlardan ta'sirlangan. Ba'zi umumiy dalillarga bolalarni tarbiyalash xarajatlarining oshishi, ayollarning kareralari bilan bandligi va yetarli darajada bolalarni parvarish qilishni qo'llab-quvvatlashning yo'qligi kiradi.

Hozirda Buyuk Britaniya, Avstraliya va AQSh kabi mamlakatlarda tug'ilish darajasi taxminan 1,4 dan 1,6 gacha. Yaponiyada bu ko'rsatkich atigi 1,2, Janubiy Koreyada esa 0,75 ni tashkil etadi. Hozirgacha bu pasayish haqidagi tushunchamiz asosan demograflar tomonidan shakllantirilgan, ular aholi tendentsiyalarini tahlil qiladi va kelajakdagi natijalarni bashorat qilishga harakat qiladi.

Biroq, Oksford universiteti xodimi Paula Sheppard bu yondashuv asosiy maqsadni o'tkazib yuboradi deb hisoblaydi. Uning fikricha, jamiyatdagi qaysi guruhlar kamroq farzand ko'rayotganini va ularning tanlovlari ortidagi turli sabablarni hisobga olish muhim.

Sheppardning tadqiqoti ko'proq individualga asoslangan yondashuvga qaratilgan bo'lib, erkaklar va ayollarning oila qurishni kechiktirish va kamroq farzand ko'rishining haqiqiy sabablarini aniqlashga qaratilgan. U zamonaviy hayot, shaharlarning ajralib qolishidan tortib zamonaviy ofis ishining talablarigacha, bizning turimizning bolalarni tarbiyalash bo'yicha tabiiy instinktlari bilan qanday to'qnash kelishini o'rganadi. Sheppardning tadqiqotlariga ko'ra, odamlar qancha farzand ko'rishni hal qilishda bir omil ayniqsa muhim.

Penni Sarchet: Hozirda tug'ilish darajasi haqida juda ko'p vahima borga o'xshaydi.

Paula Sheppard:Noto'g'ri tushuncha bor: odamlar bu hech qachon bunchalik past bo'lmagan deb o'ylashadi, lekin ular aslida [rekord past] emas. Ikkinchi jahon urushidan keyin ham stavkalar juda past edi va demograflar, siyosatchilar va siyosatchilar vahima ichida edilar. Demograflar aholi qanday bo'lishini loyihalashtirishga harakat qilishdi - tug'ilish darajasi tiklanadimi? Ammo 1940-yillarning oxirida, odamlar urushdan keyin ko'p farzand ko'rmagan paytda qilingan prognozlar aslida sodir bo'lganidan pastroq edi. Hech kim to'g'ri topa olmadi, chunki hech kim bolalar bumini bashorat qilmadi.

Shunday qilib, nima bo'lishini bashorat qilish qiyin, lekin biz o'rnini bosish darajasidan pastmiz. Juda past stavkalar mavjud, ayniqsa Janubiy Koreya va Yaponiyaga qarasangiz. Ammo shuningdek, butun Yevropa va Shimoliy Amerikada ham hech bir davlat o'rnini bosish darajasidan yuqori emas.

Bu haqda barcha signalizatsiya asoslimi?

Menimcha yo'q. Sayyorada [deyarli] 9 milliard odam bor. Biz yaqinda yo'q bo'lib ketmaymiz. "Xudoyim, biz dunyoni haddan tashqari ko'paytirdik. Odamlar och qolishmoqda. Qashshoqlik va tengsizlik dahshatli" degan qarama-qarshi argument ham bor. Ayniqsa, yosh avlod aynan shu haqda o'ylayapti.

Ammo men nima uchun ba'zi ommaviy axborot vositalari vahima qo'zg'ashni yoqtirishini va ba'zi siyosatchilarning o'z rejalari borligini tushunaman. Vahima qilmasligimiz kerak deb o'ylayman, lekin ayni paytda odamlar ikki yoki uchta farzand ko'rishni xohlasalar, ular ikki yoki uchta farzand ko'ra olishlari kerak deb o'ylayman - lekin ko'pincha ular bunday emas.

Tug'ilish darajasining pasayishini o'rganishga urinayotganda, ko'pchilik tadqiqotlar nimani o'tkazib yuboradi?

Bir muammo - narsalar haqida aholi darajasida o'ylash va narsalar haqida joylardagi shaxslar orasida o'ylash o'rtasidagi farq. [Birinchisini qilish] juda foydali emas. Agar siz mamlakatning umumiy tug'ilish koeffitsientini olsangiz, u jamiyatning turli sohalari haqida hech narsa aytmaydi, chunki turli odamlar turli narsalarni qilmoqdalar. Kambag'al odamlarda [o'rtacha] ko'proq bolalar bor va juda boy odamlarda ko'proq bolalar bor. Mamlakat darajasida ko'rish mumkin bo'lganidan ko'ra ko'proq noziklik mavjud.

Siz oilani rejalashtirishni individual darajada o'rganish uchun noyob yondashuvdan foydalanmoqdasiz. Buni qanday qildingiz?

Men Buyuk Britaniyada tadqiqot o'tkazdim, uni hozir boshqa mamlakatlarga ham kengaytirishni rejalashtirmoqdaman, bu aralash usullardan iborat loyiha edi. Biz odamlardan bu haqda gapirishlarini so'rab fokus-guruhlar o'tkazdik, shu jumladan erkaklar ham, chunki erkaklar ko'pincha bu suhbatdan chetda qolishadi va ularning nima deyishlarini eshitishni juda xohlardim.

Ushbu sifatli ishdan men odamlar uchun bolali bo'lish masalasida eng muhim narsalarning qisqa ro'yxatini tuzdim: oilalarning qo'llab-quvvatlashi, yaxshi uyga ega bo'lish, sadoqatli va amaliy sherikga ega bo'lish - siz kutishingiz mumkin bo'lgan barcha narsalar.

Va keyin men diskret tanlov tajribasini o'tkazdim, bu bunday tadqiqot uchun juda g'ayrioddiy - menimcha, men buni qilgan birinchi odamman. Bu sog'liqni saqlash iqtisodiyoti va transport fanida juda mashhur usul. Masalan, siz undan nima uchun odamlar avtobus yoki poezdda yurishni tanlashini yoki qanday qilib ko'proq hamshiralarni qishloq joylarida ishlashga ko'ndirishingiz mumkinligini o'rganish uchun foydalanishingiz mumkin. Shunday qilib, men odamlarga o'zlari xohlagan bolalar soniga ega bo'lishni qanday osonlashtirish mumkinligini so'rash uchun foydalandim? Ularga nima berishingiz kerak?

Bu tug'ilish darajasini o'rganishda odatda o'tkazib yuboriladigan noziklikni qanday qamrab oladi?

Chunki tajriba onlayn tarzda o'tkaziladi, sizda ancha katta, milliy vakillik qiluvchi ishtirokchilar havzasi bo'lishi mumkin, biz shunday qildik, garchi ishtirokchilarning aksariyati geteroseksual ekanligini ta'kidlashga arziydi. Men qisqa ro'yxatdagi har bir omil uchun reytinglarni chiqarib olishim va, masalan, qo'lda sherik yoki yaxshi uyga ega bo'lish uchun oila qurishni boshlashni qancha oylarga kechiktirishga tayyor bo'lishingiz kabi narsalarga qarashim mumkin edi.

Nimalarni topdingiz?

Ajablanarlisi yo'q, turli guruhlar uchun turli narsalar. Erkaklar va ayollar o'rtasida moslik bor edi, lekin ta'lim toifalari o'rtasida ancha ko'p farq bor edi.

Universitet diplomiga ega bo'lmagan odamlar, albatta, uy-joyga qiziqish bildirishdi, lekin ular, masalan, ipotekaga qiziqish bildirishmadi. Erkaklar mahalla sifatiga qiziqish bildirishdi: "Agar men yaxshiroq joyga ko'cha olmasam, men boshqa farzand ko'rmayman, chunki bu yerda yashil maydon yo'q va maktablar yomon". Ayollar esa: "Men bolalarning yugurib yurishi uchun yetarli joy va biroz bog' bo'lishini xohlayman - lekin men ipoteka qarziga qiziqmayman" deyishardi.

Shunday qilib, agar siz shtamp boji ta'tillarini [uy sotib olishni rag'batlantirish uchun Buyuk Britaniya soliq chorasi] haqida o'ylasangiz, siz faqat uyga egalik qilishni xohlaydigan aholi qismiga yordam beryapsiz. Ammo Buyuk Britaniyada ijaraga olish juda qiyin bo'lishiga qaramay, bunday qarzni xohlamaydigan va ijaraga olishdan xursand bo'lgan odamlar bor. Shunday qilib, ehtimol, ikki tomonlama yondashuv kerak bo'ladi.

Universitetda o'qigan odamlar qanday farq qildilar?

Darajaga ega bo'lgan ayollar otalarning birgalikda ota-ona bo'lishini xohlashdi. Darajasi bo'lmagan ayollar hech qachon yigitlarning tagliklarni almashtirishini va shu kabilarni xohlash haqida gapirmaganlar. Buning o'rniga ular sadoqatli munosabatlar haqida gapirishdi. Butun tajribadagi eng yomon ssenariy - yolg'iz ona sifatida chaqaloq bilan yolg'iz qolish edi. Ammo oliy ma'lumotli ayollar otalarning amaliy bo'lishini xohlashdi, bu boshqa turdagi yordamdir.

Ayollar shunchaki bolalarning o'rnini bosish darajasiga ega bo'lishni xohlamaydimi va ko'proq ma'lumotga ega bo'lgan ayollar qancha farzand ko'rishni nazorat qilishadi deb o'yladim. Ammo sizning ishingiz shuni ko'rsatdiki, ular xohlaganidan kamroq farzand ko'rishmoqda?

Albatta. Odamlar hali ham ikki yoki uchta farzand ko'rishni xohlashadi. Hamma ham emas - umuman farzand ko'rishni xohlamaydiganlar ham bor. Ammo Buyuk Britaniyada xohlagan har uchta chaqaloq uchun faqat ikkitasi tug'iladi.

Biroq, oliy ma'lumotli ayollar, agar ota ular kabi birgalikda ota-ona sifatida sarmoya kiritishiga ishonch hosil qilmaguncha, farzand ko'rmaslikka tayyor. Menimcha, buning sababi ayollar yuqori martaba jarimasini olishadi. Ayollar: "Bu shunchaki bir yillik tug'ruq ta'tili emas. Bu ta'lim darajasi va kamroq farzand ko'rish o'rtasidagi bog'liqlikni keltirib chiqaradi. Oliy ma'lumotli erkaklar: "U tayyor bo'lganda, men tayyorman" deyishadi, lekin bu ayollar aralashishga tayyor bo'lgan erkakni kutishadi.

Universitetda o'qigan erkaklar ko'proq nimaga e'tibor berishdi?

Ular ishda moslashuvchanlik kabi narsalarni izlashardi - kerak bo'lganda ta'til olish va uydan ishlash imkoniyati. Bu amaliy ota-ona bo'lishga qodir bo'lish haqida ko'p narsani aytadi. Menimcha, erkaklar uchun yaxshiroq ota-ona ta'tilini o'ylash juda muhim, chunki bu bolalar, shuningdek, otalar va ularning farzandlari o'rtasidagi munosabatlar uchun foydali va ayollar uchun ham foydali.

Bolani tarbiyalash uchun bir qishloq kerakligi hammaga ma'lum va urbanizatsiya tufayli har qachongidan ham ko'proq odamlar bu qishloqqa ega emaslar.

Bu masalaning mohiyati. Ijtimoiy qo'llab-quvvatlash tadqiqotdagi eng muhim narsa edi. Bizning turimizning o'ziga xos xususiyati shundaki, ayol odamlar bir vaqtning o'zida bir nechta qaram bolalarga ega bo'lishga qodir. Masalan, buni shimpanzelarda ko'rmaysiz. Ular nasl yetarlicha katta bo'lguncha kutishadi, shunda ona vafot etsa, yoshlar omon qolishi mumkin, keyin ular boshqa naslga ega bo'lishadi - shuning uchun har yetti yilda bir marta. Odamlar bilan siz har ikki yilda bir marta farzand ko'rishingiz mumkin va agar ona vafot etsa, bolalar o'lmaydi, chunki ota, buvi-buvalar yoki "qishloq" bor.

Bu hamkorlikda ko'payish bizni tom ma'noda inson qiladi va men o'rgangan har bir guruhda ular sherigi yoki ota-onalari tomonidan qo'llab-quvvatlanishni xohlashdi. Oliy ma'lumotli ayollar ham do'stlarining yordamini xohlashdi - ular qo'shilishlari mumkin bo'lgan onalar guruhlari borligini va ularning do'stlari ham farzand ko'rayotganini bilishni xohlashdi.

Ko'pincha turmush darajasining yuqoriligi odamlarning kamroq farzand ko'rishining sababi ekanligi aytiladi - uy-joy va bolalarni parvarish qilish bilan bog'liq xarajatlar juda qimmatga tushdi. Bu sizning tadqiqotingizda muhim omil sifatida chiqdimi?

Turmush darajasi va bolalarni parvarish qilish bilan bog'liq moliyaviy masalalar hamma uchun muhim edi, lekin qizig'i shundaki, sherigingiz yoki ijtimoiy yordamning boshqa manbalari kabi narsalar unchalik muhim emas edi. Bu mantiqan, chunki agar sizda yaxshi qo'llab-quvvatlash tarmog'i bo'lsa, bolalarni parvarish qilish xarajatlarini kamaytirish mumkin. Masalan, agar buvi-buvalar haftada bir yoki ikki kun bolalarga g'amxo'rlik qila olsalar, bu adolatli tejashga aylanishi mumkin.

Sizningcha, oliy ma'lumotli ayollar 30 yoshga to'lmasdan farzand ko'rishni g'ayrioddiy deb bilishadi, bu antropologik nuqtai nazardan juda keksa. Bunga nima sabab bo'ldi?

Menimcha, odamlar uzoq kutishining sababi shundaki, oilalar oila qurishga yoki boshqa farzand ko'rishga tayyor bo'lishdan oldin barcha mashhur o'rdaklarni bir qatorga qo'yishga qiynalmoqdalar. Agar siz ish va ota-onalikni yanada mos qilsangiz, menimcha, odamlar yoshroq farzand ko'rishadi.

Va keyin, oila qurishni kechroq boshlash odamlarga xohlaganidek ko'p farzand ko'rish uchun kamroq vaqt qoldiradi?

Ha - xohlagan bolalar soni va olgan bolalar soni o'rtasidagi farqning katta qismi kechikish bilan bog'liq. Bu nafaqat oliy ma'lumotli ayollarda: boshqa ayollar ham kechroq, 20 yoshlarning oxirida farzand ko'rishmoqda.

Bularning barchasi qanchalik darajada global miqyosda qo'llaniladi?

Bu nafaqat Yevropa. Dunyoning juda past tug'ilish darajasi bo'lmagan yagona qismi - Sahroi Kabirdan janubiy Afrika, lekin u shunday bo'lyapti; bu faqat vaqt masalasi.

Ammo global miqyosda butunlay boshqa narsalar o'ynayapti. Masalan, Bangladeshda tug'ilish darajasi past - har bir oilaga taxminan 2 ta bola - lekin ayollar [odatda] erta turmush qurishadi, taxminan 18 yoshda. Ular birinchi farzandini 19 yoshda, ikkinchi farzandini 22 yoshda tug'ishadi, keyin to'xtashadi, shuning uchun ular ham kamroq farzand ko'rishmoqda, lekin bu Buyuk Britaniyada ko'rayotgan bu kechikish ishi bilan hech qanday aloqasi yo'q.

Men eshitganman, tug'ilish darajasini pasaytirish ancha oson - masalan, ta'lim va kontratseptsiya mavjudligi orqali - ularni ko'tarishdan ko'ra. Dunyo miqyosida ishlagan siyosatlar bormi?
